scenes.narration: What should we measure next? Deflection alone cannot distinguish stiffness from load. The experiment planner shows why an independent load measurement is more informative under its assumptions.

scientific_limits: No biological organism built or flight validated
No general matched-budget multiagent advantage established: recorded comparison was a ceiling/tie
BioNeMo runtime not established; OpenFold2 provider explicitly reported upstream-source-not-nim
OpenResearch use is local run recording/replay, not a cloud dispatcher
All experiment-planner covariance results are prospective under assumed priors/noise
Do not present rendered concept meshes as simulation or measured biology
Do not cite unmeasured cumulative token spend or imply all16sharedH100s were ours
editing_rules: Use real captured UI and real saved simulation frames. Camera motion/crossfades are presentation only.
Do not stretch scientific time unnoticed; label changed playback speed.
Pause busy montage before readable result cards; use visual contrast and large text.
Narration may be synthesized scene-wise; preserve exact script, record model/voice/parameters/providerusage.
If scene speech exceeds budget, report and tighten script; do not cut words or severely speed voice.
Render subtitles, poster, source/hash manifest, and 1min/2min MP4; inspect frames and audio/video durations.
